Package com.agrialert.alert_manager.domain

Class AlertEvaluator

java.lang.Object
com.agrialert.alert_manager.domain.AlertEvaluator
public class AlertEvaluator extends Object
Evaluates weather data against configured thresholds to produce candidate alerts for the alert manager workflow.

  • Method Details

    • evaluate

      public List<Alert> evaluate(WeatherApiResponse weather, Field field, String groupName, List<AlertWithThreshold> activeAlerts)
      Generates alert candidates for the given field based on the supplied weather response and active alert thresholds. Returned alerts are not persisted.
      Parameters:
      weather - weather response providing current and hourly forecasts
      field - field metadata used for identifiers and location context
      groupName - optional group name override; falls back to the field group name
      activeAlerts - active alert definitions with their thresholds
      Returns:
      a list of alert candidates, or an empty list when inputs are missing or no match occurs

    • addIfForecastMatches

      private void addIfForecastMatches(List<Alert> result, AlertType type, Field field, String groupName, List<Double> values, List<String> times, int startIndex, AlertEvaluator.ThresholdPredicate predicate, String title, AlertEvaluator.ValueFormatter descriptionFormatter, int iconRes)
      Adds a new alert to the result list if the first matching forecast value is found.
      Parameters:
      result - destination list for new alerts
      type - alert type metadata
      field - field context for the alert
      groupName - optional group name override
      values - hourly series to scan
      times - ISO timestamps aligned with the series
      startIndex - index from which to start scanning the hourly series
      predicate - condition used to match a forecast value
      title - alert title to use
      descriptionFormatter - formatter for the alert description
      iconRes - icon resource identifier

    • addIfForecastMatchesPaired
